page.overview:
What is Innsmouth?

Innsmouth is a fictional location introduced in the H. P. Lovecraft story The Shadow Over Innsmouth. It is a seaside town in Essex County, Massachusetts, run by the Esoteric Order of Dagon and their Deep One allies until their destruction in 1928. Since its first appearance, it has appeared in numerous Cthulhu Mythos stories written by various authors.

Another town named Innsmouth (also fictional) is located in England (: "Celephaïs", : "Shoggoth's Old Peculiar"), but this one is mentioned far less frequently.

The Manuxet River runs through the centre of town, before turning southward to join the ocean at the end of the harbour's breakwater; Newburyport is an hour's bus ride down the coast.

As it fell into disrepair under the control of the Deep Ones, by 1927, the town lacked a public library or a chamber of commerce. Many of the street signs had also been removed, making navigation difficult for outsiders. In general, the South is less populous, but the north is more dangerous.

Also known as: Innsmouth MA.
